provider: Alibaba Cloud ACR Enterprise Edition / OSS-backed registries (structural note, not a candidate)

free_tier.stated: Enterprise Edition stores artifacts in YOUR OSS bucket, so 'registry storage' is just OSS storage and is billed as OSS pay-as-you-go. There is no free allowance.

egress.terms: OSS outbound traffic is charged unless you disable public network access and pull only over a VPC endpoint.

tooling: oras / docker push; the registry is a façade over OSS.
chaining: None — it inherits OSS pricing, which is metered.
reliability_note: Documented here only because it explains a trap: several 'free registry' pages (Alibaba EE, Baidu CCR EE) are OSS/BOS front-ends whose real cost sits in the bucket.

evidence.proved: read live: 'Enterprise Edition stores cloud-native artifacts such as container images and Helm charts in your OSS buckets. This may incur storage and traffic fees.'
